Hello , I have a basic question: I am trying to run this snippet from page 19 of the Mathematics in Lean book by Avigad and Massot :

However, Lean is unable to find abs_add. I'm wondering if there's an import that I'm missing.

I am using the online Lean compiler https://live.lean-lang.org .
Mathematics in Lean uses an older version of Lean/mathlib. It seems like the lemma is called docs#abs_add_le now.
Also when you have such nice information about the type you want, it is a perfect time to try out loogle!
Thanks for the tip ! I'll keep it in mind

By the way in your second screenshot, you import Mathlib and then import specific files of Mathlib: that is not necessary. Whenever you import Mathlib, you are actually importing all files in the library, thus the other imports are redundant. One nice trick is first to import Mathlib, write all your proofs and definitions, and then write the command #min_imports and the end of your file. It will show in the infoview the minimum imports required for your file to compile!
